name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new algorithm, board, integration, or validation check
labels: enhancement
---

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve for downstream
Zephyr / PQC integrators?

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you would like to see. Include any concrete touch
points you can identify (Kconfig symbol, module source file, ztest
suite, release-gate step, CI workflow). If the feature introduces a
new public API, note whether it crosses the immutable-contract
boundary (see `PROJECT_NOTES.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you evaluated and why you did not propose them.

## Additional context

Relevant standards references (FIPS 203, FIPS 204, ACVP, RFCs),
upstream discussions, benchmark data, or security analyses.
